scope: One bounded Linux-only operational calibration/analysis resource and cooperative cancellation profile; no performance acceptance, statistical validation, or method change.

generator.stream: Python random.Random(seed), fresh independent stream for each size; record interpreter version
generator.entityIds: Group letter plus 1-based zero-padded four-digit entity index; globally unique across groups
generator.encoding: UTF-8 CSV; LF; values formatted to 9 decimal places
generator.positivity: Bounded generator yields strictly positive nondegenerate repeated measurements

cancellation.signal: SIGINT once to the launched child session if still running after 1 second
cancellation.expectedStdout: Exactly one mvs-cli-result/v1 JSON error object
cancellation.expectedOutput: No completed calibration_state.json/run_manifest.json; machine artifacts empty and outputDirectory/manifestPath null
cancellation.fallback: Wait up to 10 seconds after SIGINT, then SIGKILL only the owned process session; record as failure

executionPolicy.retry: None; preserve failures and skip larger datasets
executionPolicy.coldMeaning: One fresh CLI process per case, no warmup; host filesystem/cache coldness is not controlled
executionPolicy.affinity: os.sched_setaffinity(0, first two sorted allowed CPUs) in child preexec only; sample observed child affinity; preserve parent affinity
executionPolicy.rssWatchdog: Sample launched process VmRSS at approximately 50 ms; SIGKILL owned session if >768 MiB; kernel peak above threshold also fails even if between samples
executionPolicy.resourceAccounting: os.wait4(exact_child_pid, WNOHANG); per-child ru_utime/ru_stime and Linux ru_maxrss KiB; never cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN
executionPolicy.capture: stdout/stderr directly to new files; stdin /dev/null; new process session; no PIPEs
executionPolicy.output: Fresh evidence directory outside source; refuse existing evidence/summary/archive; preserve inputs and captures on failure
executionPolicy.backups: MVS_DISABLE_BACKUPS=1 and task-local MVS_BACKUP_DIR; resume is not tested
executionPolicy.environment: DOTNET_ROOT=/tmp/mvs-dotnet, DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/tmp/mvs-dotnet-home, NUGET_PACKAGES=/tmp/mvs-nuget/packages; task-local XDG data/config/cache; remove optional DOTNET_/COMPlus_ overrides except named environment
executionPolicy.runtimeIdentity: Installed SDK 8.0.425 and runtime 8.0.31; process coreclr mapped paths retained in samples

interpretationLimits: One process per case on one shared Linux environment; no repeated timing estimates, warmup, speedup comparison, cross-platform evidence, or capacity guarantee.
Cold means fresh process only; OS cache state and host contention are uncontrolled. Timings include process startup and I/O.
Only standard three-independent-group summary calibration/analysis is profiled; variance, estimation, MELSM, Python wrapper overhead, Windows/macOS, and resume are not tested.
100 calibration repetitions are an operational smoke budget, not adequate scientific calibration or FPR/power evidence. No inference of numerical/scientific correctness from timings.

RSS watchdog samples the launched process at about 50 ms and is not a hard allocation cap or a full process-tree memory limit. Exact kernel peak is reported separately; CPU/RSS are wait4 accounting for the launched child.
Cancellation is one SIGINT during a long synthetic calibration; backup/resume, export-time cancellation, all phases, and every workload are not covered.
Engine 1.6.2, the active twelve-metric Bonferroni family, and the full development baseline NO-GO remain unchanged.
